# Descriptions
@@ 1
Caster can repair 1 sprain (no recovery time).
@@ 2
Caster can repair 1 damaged muscle. Recovery time is 5-50 minutes.
@@ 3
Caster can repair 1 damaged tendon. Recovery time is 5-50 minutes.
@@ 4
As Muscle Repair I, except caster can repair 3 damaged muscles.
@@ 5
A Tendon Repair I, except caster can repair 3 damaged tendons.
@@ 7
Allows caster to reattach severed limb. Also requires the use of Bone Ways,
Blood Ways, and Organ Ways Joining spells to restore limb to functional
status. Limb will be fulling functional in 1-10 days.
@@ 8
As Muscle Repair I, except recovery is instantaneous.
@@ 9
As Tendon Repair I, except recovery is instantaneous.
@@ 11
Caster can repair a number of damaged muscles equal to his level. Recovery
time is 5-50 minutes.
@@ 12
Caster can regenerate any 1 muscle. Recovery time is 5-50 minutes.
@@ 13
Caster can repair a number of damaged tendons equal to his level. Recovery
time is 5-50 minutes.
@@ 14
Caster can regenerate any 1 tendon. Recovery time is 5-50 minutes.
@@ 15
As Joining, except caster must cast the other 3 Healer Joining True spells and
recovery is instantaneous.
@@ 17
As Muscle Regeneration, except recovery time is 1-10 minutes.
@@ 19
As Tendon Regeneration, except recovery time is 1-10 minutes.
@@ 20
Caster can regenerate any 1 muscle or tendon. Recovery time is instantaneous.
@@ 25
Caster can regenerate all of the muscles in his body. Recovery time is 5-50
minutes.
@@ 30
Caster can regenerate all of the tendons in his body. Recovery time is 5-50
minutes.
@@ 50
Caster can repair a number of damaged muscles and/or tendons equal to his
level. Recovery is instantaneous.
